text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion is victorious at the Arima 
Kinen. Amidst roaring cheers, Daiwa 
Scarlet congratulates her on her win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Air Shakur mocked her own 
defeat. She revealed that while struggling 
against the outcome preordained by data, 
she had seen hope in Fine Motion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If only they could prevent her return to 
her home country, they believed it might 
change their own destiny. Yet, the outcome 
remained unchanged. Even so—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion saw through to the fact that 
she hadn't given up, entrusting her with 
the role of changing the ending. And with 
that, she bid her farewell.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race, Fine Motion announces her 
return home at a press conference. Tears 
glistened in her eyes...
